title: give the reviewer one test per command in the Base overlays section, so a read-only reviewer never needs a -run regex with a pipe

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-195317-44e4, project ork, item S581:

give the reviewer one test per command in the Base overlays section, so a read-only reviewer never needs a -run regex with a pipe

Evidence: `-run TestUIPassStartsWithAnEmptyRendersDirectory|TestRendersIgnoreASymlinkedDirectory` was denied as multiple operations
